data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 – Refund of €550.00
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielstadt issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, setting income tax at €8,990.00 against withheld wage tax of €9,540.00, resulting in a refund of €550.00 to be credited to the recipient's account.
data.explanation: This letter from the tax office finalizes your 2025 income tax. You are due a refund of €550.00, which will be paid automatically into your account — you don't need to do anything for that. If you disagree with any figure in the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline shown for this. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final. Keep this document for your records, as it may be useful for future tax filings or comparisons.

key_facts.label: Deemed delivery rule (Bekanntgabe)
key_facts.quote: Er gilt am vierten Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben, es sei denn, er ist nicht oder später zugegangen.

key_facts.label: Craftsman services deduction recognized (Handwerkerleistungen § 35a EStG)
key_facts.quote: Ihre Angaben zu den Handwerkerleistungen (§ 35a EStG) wurden übernommen.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with this assessment, submit an objection to the Finanzamt in writing, electronically, or for the record before the deadline shown.
items.consequence: The assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.

items.title: Receive the tax refund (Erstattung)
items.quote: Der Betrag wird Ihrem Konto gutgeschrieben.

date.text: Der Betrag wird Ihrem Konto gutgeschrieben.
